confidence_note: Data quality is lower here than other providers. Only one number (to_bank transfer cap) is confirmed via an official Safaricom Ethiopia channel. All other figures (P2P wallet tiers, cash-out) come from a third-party fee-comparison site, not Safaricom directly, and are marked accordingly.

records.notes: Confirmed via official Safaricom Ethiopia X/Twitter post: transfer up to 75,000 birr to any bank costs a maximum of 5 birr. No official tiered breakdown found -- treated as a single flat-capped fee across the full range.

known_gaps.action: Follow up by checking the M-Pesa Ethiopia app directly (fee schedules are often shown in-app before confirming a transaction) or visiting a physical agent outlet, per the official T&Cs, before treating the tiered figures as reliable.
